quality_guards: Emergency-alert live state is stored with its verification timestamp and is not treated as a durable area score.
Cell-broadcast coverage and device compatibility do not prove that every individual device received an alert.
Emergency Alerts complement rather than replace other warning channels.
OPSS catalogue counts and visible result batches are dynamic snapshots.
An OPSS report or recall is product-specific and is not converted into a parcel safety score.
Product risk level, category and corrective measure remain separate fields.
Gas safety evidence records legal and operational duties rather than inferring that an individual property is compliant.
Gas work requires registration and task-specific competence; post-work sign-off is not a substitute for lawful installation.
Approximate national carbon-monoxide mortality is not a local incident rate.
ORR annual-report conclusions are sector assessments and not parcel-level measurements.
ORR's 2025-26 statistical release is due separately in September 2026 and is not inferred in advance.
Current source verification does not replace 130-candidate/16-endpoint live parity, browser DOM/console acceptance, commit ancestry, publisher push or remote readback.
No second runner was started; the stale single-runner recovery blocker remains OPEN.
